To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
transition metal doped CT TOCs are more effective than non-metal doped TOCs in photocurrent response under visible light irradiations.
the photocurrent response properties can be enhanced by both transition-metal doping and CT from chromophores.
transition metal doping and chromophores anchoring can improve the photocurrent response properties of TOCs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of new TiO2-based photocatalysts with high photocurrent response properties.
the effects of transition metal doping and chromophoric ligand anchoring on the photoelectrochemical properties of titanium-oxoclusters.
the design, synthesis, and photoelectrochemical properties of a new class of transition metal-doped CT Ti-oxo clusters.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the photocurrent response properties of TOCs can be improved by transition metal doping as well as charge transfer.
both the transition metal doping and the charge transfer play a significant role in photocurrent response of TOCs.
the photocurrent density of TOCs depends on the nature of the metal dopants and chromophore ligands.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
transition metal doped clusters and CT TOCs can be considered as promising candidates for visible-light-driven photocatalysts.
transition metal doping and chromophores coordination are two effective ways for the enhancement of photocurrent response of the TOC based photoelectrodes.
transition-metal doping and anchoring chromophore to TOC core are both effective in improving the photocurrent conversion efficiency of TOCs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the photocurrent density of Ti-oxo-cluster can be improved by doping transition-metal ions.
metal doping can improve the photocurrent response properties of Ti-oxo-cluster electrodes, and the redox activity of transition metals can further enhance the photocurrent response.
transition metal doping and chromophoric anchoring can be used in tandem to enhance the visible light photocurrent conversion of TiO2 based photoelectrodes.
